latestVersion.changelog:
**Adds Perplexity Sonar answer-generation endpoints and removes deprecated full text/smart search.**

- Integrated new Perplexity Sonar family endpoints (sonar, sonar-pro, sonar-reasoning-pro, sonar-deep-research) for answer generation with citations.
- Removed deprecated `/search/full` and `/search/smart` endpoints from docs and workflow.
- Updated documentation and examples to focus on Perplexity Sonar APIs for advanced, citation-rich searches and deep research reports.
- Adjusted quick start and Python client instructions to cover new endpoints and usage.
- Slight metadata update: new emoji and clarified description.
- All other structured search (web, scholar, Tavily) endpoints remain supported.
